decisions.reason: Polymer concrete drain housings are a core, compatible base component of the drainage families and fit long product cycles in sanitary manufacturing.
The designer shower drain is the flagship of the firm's design-focused direction, so withdrawing it within a year is unlikely.
The sloped shower element supports the move toward integrated, low-profile floor-level showers, though it is less prominent and could be consolidated.
The DallSafe backflow-protected basement drain serves a durable safety niche with growing relevance from heavy-rain events.
The air-admittance valve is a peripheral but low-cost complementary item that rounds out the installer range, so it is likely kept despite its low visibility.
